remarks: Move right into this beautifully updated 2BR townhouse in the desirable waterfront community of Dorlon Terrace on Gregory Point. This light-filled home features a spectacular kitchen with stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar, and hardwood floors throughout. The primary bath has been newly renovated, complemented by an updated powder room. Major improvements include newer windows and sliders (2019), new dishwasher , newer washer/dryer and new water heater - all included for your convenience. Dorlon Terrace offers the perfect balance - not too large, not too small - with exceptional waterfront amenities. Enjoy walking and biking along Gregory Boulevard, boating with marina slips available to residents (as available), and a beautiful association pool overlooking the water. The clubhouse may be reserved for private gatherings and celebrations. Ideally located in East Norwalk with easy access to shopping, dining, beaches, and a short walk to the train, Shore and Country Club and Shorehaven Country Club - making commuting and coastal living effortless. This one checks all the boxes - and it won't last.
